# glimm

> Shader-driven page transitions for React and Next.js. About 11 KB, GPU-composited, drop-in.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://glimm.dev/): Library overview and interactive examples.
- [Full text reference](https://glimm.dev/llms-full.txt): The library's existing README, including Next.js, React and vanilla JavaScript usage.
- [Installation](https://glimm.dev/#installation): Install glimm with npm.
- [Quick start](https://glimm.dev/#quick-start): Set up GlimmProvider.
- [Triggers](https://glimm.dev/#triggers): TransitionLink, useTransitionRouter and InterceptLinks.
- [Presets](https://glimm.dev/#presets): Built-in palettes.
- [Props](https://glimm.dev/#props): Configuration reference.
- [Best practices](https://glimm.dev/#best-practices): When to use transitions.
- [Agent skill](https://glimm.dev/#skill): Installation and usage with coding agents.
- [HTML-in-Canvas](https://glimm.dev/#html-in-canvas): Experimental page effects and browser support.

## Package and releases

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/glimm): Published package and installation information.
- [Changelog](https://glimm.dev/changelog): Published releases and changes.
